what: Moon Faire: Io's herbs, plants and rest spots, as Chris chose them. For the open world, the fight piece and the menus to read.
chosen: Chris, November 15, 2026 (7:38 am, 7:54 am and 12:56 pm). See the project note claude/herbs-and-rest-spots.md.
rule: A fight starts with the HP and MP the party has. Outside a fight, Io's herbs are how the party is healed.

hpHerb.scale: HP on the scale where the Jester has 1,000 at level 1; like every HP number it grows 20% a level
hpHerb.why: half the Jester's own heal of 120, the weakest heal

mpHerb.scale: MP on the engine's own scale (Io has 120, the Fox 100, the Jester 60)

afterAFight: One press, "top everybody up", brings the whole party to full HP and MP while herbs last.
inAFight: A witch may eat one herb in place of her move. It is the same size as outside a fight, and it takes her turn.
bag: No limit that a player will meet (show up to 999 of each).

plants.note: About one HP plant and two MP plants to pick for every walking fight, across the game about 180 and 350. She may pick more in a safer ring and carry them into a harder one.

restSpot: Refills all HP and MP for free. Gives no herbs.

restSpotsInsideRings.note: Sized for a careful, attentive player who picks as she goes and does not stock up. Every ring also has a rest spot where it begins.

lastFight.note: Before the last fight the game offers four settings. The party stops at level 20.

notDecided.faintedAfterAWonFight: As built: she gets up with 10% of her HP. Chris has not said.
notDecided.spellsBetweenFights: As built: none. Herbs are how the party heals outside a fight.

restSpotBeforeTheLastFight: Yes: one just outside the place where the final boss is fought (Chris, November 15, 4:18 pm). A party that falls in that fight starts again from before its first form.
